title: Microscopic Unitarity and the Quantization of Black Hole Evaporation Time
summary: This work presents an effective microscopic, time-dependent Hamiltonian framework for investigating information dynamics during black hole evaporation. While current approaches often rely on gravitational path integrals or statistical ensembles to recover the Page curve, our model provides an explicit, unitary quantum-mechanical evolution of the radiation. We utilize the Independent Unitary Pairing assumption, where the total Hilbert space is decomposed into N_{total} mutually independent bipartite subsystems.
